Here is how to mark your missing iPhone as lost, using Find My on your iPad:
1. In the **Find My** app, go to the **Devices** tab.
2. Scroll down and select your missing iPhone.
3. Tap **More**.
4. Scroll down to **Lost iPhone**, then turn on **Lost Mode**.
5. If you want to show your contact information on the device, follow the onscreen steps.
6. Tap **Activate**.

If Stolen Device Protection is on, Face ID or Touch ID is required to turn off Lost Mode, even if someone knows your passcode.

My Chromebook screen is too small for me to read my email. Everything looks tiny. How do I make the whole screen bigger? I'm not good with computers, so simple steps please.

Here is how to make your whole Chromebook screen bigger:
1. Select the time at the bottom right, or press **Alt + Shift + S**.
2. Select **Settings**, then **Accessibility**.
3. Under **Display**, turn on **Full screen magnifier**.
4. Choose how the magnified view moves with your mouse: **Move screen continuously as mouse moves**, **Move screen keeping mouse at center of screen**, or **Move screen when mouse touches edge of screen**.
5. To increase magnification, press **Ctrl + Alt + Brightness up**. To decrease it, press **Ctrl + Alt + Brightness down**.

I opened Camera from Google and pointed it at the code, but no banner came up. I never tapped QR.

You can't scan a QR code in portrait and video mode, so check that first.
1. Tap **QR**, then point the camera at the code.
2. Tap the banner that appears to open the browser page, app, or payments app.
If you don't see **QR**, this feature is available only on selected devices.
